__documentation__.purpose: Developer-maintained validation rules for generated tool outputs compared to gold-standard files.
how_to_use: Add one top-level key per tool basename (example: ConvertDOMINO, ConvertEDFbrowser).
Each tool must define a non-empty comparisons array.
Each item in comparisons defines one generated file to compare against one gold-standard file.
If generated and gold names are identical, use fileName only.
fileType: Use 'bag-comparison' for unordered line comparison (order-independent, counts must match), 'generic' for strict line-by-line order preservation, or 'report' for ordered comparison.
comparisons[].delimiter: Optional delimiter override for text normalization when relevant.
comparisons[].maxDiffLines: Optional maximum number of diff lines to print in mismatch logs.

fields.<ToolName>: Top-level key for one tool configuration. Must match the JSON filename of the tool in CEAMSTools package.
fields.comparisons: Array of comparison rules executed for this tool.
fields.comparisons[].fileName: Preferred single filename used for both generated output and gold-standard reference.
fields.comparisons[].fileType: Comparison mode used by compare_outputs.py (examples: bag-comparison, generic, report).
fields.comparisons[].generatedSearchRoots: Ordered list of roots scanned recursively to find generatedFileName.
fields.comparisons[].precision: Optional integer precision for numeric normalization before comparison. Omit to disable rounding.
fields.comparisons[].delimiter: Optional delimiter override for text normalization when relevant.
fields.comparisons[].maxDiffLines: Optional maximum number of diff lines to print in mismatch logs.

notes: Keep generatedSearchRoots as specific and as short as possible.
For stable CI validation, prefer writing outputs under validation-workspaces and private-dataset only.
Unknown top-level keys are ignored by the current workflow as long as tool names are requested explicitly.
